name: Leg press
cues: Feet shoulder-width, mid-platform
Lower until knees reach about 90 degrees
Press through the heels, never lock out hard

name: Leg extension
cues: Pad on the lower shin, back against the seat
Lift smoothly, pause at the top
Lower slowly over 3 seconds

name: Seated leg curl
cues: Hips pinned to the seat
Curl under control, squeeze at the end
Return slowly, do not let the stack drop

name: Lying leg curl
cues: Hips down on the pad, pad just above the heels
Curl without lifting the hips
Lower over 3 seconds

name: Chest press machine
cues: Handles level with mid-chest, shoulder blades back
Press without shrugging
Stop just short of locking the elbows

name: Shoulder press machine
cues: Seat so the handles start at ear height
Press up without arching the back
Lower to ear level, ribs down

name: Lat pulldown
cues: Grip just wider than the shoulders
Pull the elbows down toward the ribs
Lean back slightly, chest up, no swinging

name: Seated row
cues: Chest against the pad, shoulders down
Pull the elbows back, squeeze the shoulder blades
Let the arms extend fully, under control

name: Pec deck
cues: Elbows slightly bent, at chest height
Bring the arms together in an arc
Open only as far as feels comfortable in the shoulders

name: Rear delt fly machine
cues: Chest on the pad, arms at shoulder height
Sweep the arms out and back
Squeeze the shoulder blades, no jerking

name: Triceps press machine
cues: Elbows tucked beside the ribs
Press down to full extension
Return slowly until the elbows are bent about 90 degrees

name: Biceps curl machine
cues: Upper arms flat on the pad
Curl up, squeeze, no shoulder shrug
Lower fully over 3 seconds

name: Abdominal crunch machine
cues: Round the spine, bring ribs toward hips
Exhale as you crunch
Do not pull with the arms

name: Hip abduction machine
cues: Sit tall, back against the pad
Push the knees out in a smooth arc
Return slowly, do not let the weights clang

name: Hip adduction machine
cues: Sit tall, set a comfortable starting width
Squeeze the legs together
Return slowly

name: Tilt-seat calf raise
cues: Balls of the feet on the platform
Lower into a full stretch, pause
Rise as high as you can, slowly

name: Assisted pull-up machine
cues: Choose an assist that allows full reps
Pull the chest toward the bar
Lower to straight arms under control

name: Hip thrust machine
cues: Upper back on the pad, feet flat
Drive the hips up, chin tucked
Squeeze the glutes at the top, ribs down

name: Cable row
cues: Sit tall, slight knee bend
Pull the handle to the lower ribs
Reach forward under control, do not round the back

name: Rope triceps pushdown
cues: Elbows pinned to the sides
Push down and spread the rope at the bottom
Return until the forearms are level

name: Cable curl
cues: Stand tall, elbows fixed beside the ribs
Curl without swinging the body
Lower slowly to full extension

name: Face pull
cues: Rope at head height, pull toward the face
Elbows high, hands finish beside the ears
Keep the ribs down and the neck relaxed

name: Cable chest fly
cues: Slight forward lean, soft elbows
Bring the hands together in an arc
Stop when you feel the chest stretch, not the shoulder

name: Cable lateral raise
cues: Lift the elbow out to the side, to shoulder height
Lead with the elbow, not the hand
Lower slowly, no body swing

name: Cable crunch
cues: Kneel, rope beside the head
Curl the ribs toward the hips
Hips stay still, no pulling with the arms

name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Shoulder blades pinched, feet planted
Lower to the sides of the chest
Press up and slightly in

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
cues: Seated with the back supported
Press up without arching
Lower to ear height under control

name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: Hand and knee on a bench, flat back
Pull the elbow toward the hip
Lower fully, no twisting

name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold the weight at the chest, elbows in
Sit down between the hips, chest up
Stop where the knees feel fine, then stand

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push the hips back
Dumbbells slide along the thighs
Stop when the hamstrings stretch, back flat

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
cues: Slight bend in the elbows
Raise to shoulder height, thumbs level
Lower slowly, no shrugging

name: Dumbbell curl
cues: Elbows fixed beside the ribs
Curl and turn the palms up
Lower slowly, no swinging

name: Split squat
cues: Long stride, torso upright
Lower straight down, front heel planted
Drive up through the front foot

name: Barbell back squat
cues: Bar across the upper back, brace the core
Sit down and back to a comfortable depth
Knees track over the toes, drive up

name: Barbell bench press
cues: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades back
Lower to mid-chest, elbows about 45 degrees
Press up, feet planted, use a spotter

name: Deadlift
cues: Bar over mid-foot, flat back
Push the floor away, hips and shoulders rise together
Lock out with the glutes, lower under control

name: Barbell row
cues: Hinge to about 45 degrees, flat back
Pull the bar to the lower ribs
Lower under control, no heaving

name: Overhead press
cues: Ribs down, glutes tight
Press the bar straight up, head moves through
Lock out over the shoulders

name: Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, hips travel back
Bar close to the legs
Stop at the hamstring stretch, back flat

name: Barbell hip thrust
cues: Upper back on a bench, bar padded over the hips
Drive up until the shins are vertical
Chin tucked, squeeze the glutes at the top

name: Plank
cues: Elbows under shoulders, body in one line
Squeeze the glutes and brace the abs
Breathe, do not let the hips sag

name: Dead bug
cues: Lower back pressed into the floor
Extend opposite arm and leg slowly
Return before the back arches

name: Push-up
cues: Hands under shoulders, body in one line
Lower the chest to the floor, elbows about 45 degrees
Raise the incline of the hands if reps break down

name: Glute bridge
cues: Feet flat, knees bent
Drive the hips up, squeeze the glutes
Do not over-arch the lower back

name: Bird dog
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips
Extend opposite arm and leg, hips level
Pause one second, return slowly
